messages:
naomi: Heads-up: ClearWell Health wants to run a quick POC using a new variant (noisy name: aurum-compact-16b) for conversational triage + long-context embeddings. Theyre PHI-heavy and asked whether we can onboard the model and what the timeline/cost looks like.

diego: aurum-compact-16b not in our catalog. We can onboard but need artifacts: model weights (HF or s3), tokenizer files, example prompts (~1k), expected max_context, and target latency SLO. Also confirm license/redistribution.

sana: From ML infra: compact = quantized option. Well run q4_k / q5_k candidates. For 16k+ context we must validate KV cache behavior and memory per-token. If they truly use 32k it changes GPU choices. Request sample long-docs.

ev an: Security note: PHI requires Private or Dedicated with BAA. Need DPO contact, data flow diagram, and confirmation of whether embeddings store PHI. For embeddings-on-PHI we require encrypted-at-rest indexes + RBAC.

sec-bot: security-checklist: questionnaire uploaded to deal binder.

diego: Proposed onboarding steps: 1) Obtain artifacts + tokenizer + 1k prompts. 2) Tokenizer roundtrip & edge-case tests. 3) Crash/smoke forward pass. 4) Quantization candidates + perf sweep on A100/H100. 5) Quality evals (medical extraction accuracy). 6) If PHI, recommend Private/Dedicated with KMS + audit logs. 7) Canary deploy + SLA.

naomi: Customer asked: can you do model validation in 5 business days after artifact handoff? Also whats a ballpark for 100M gen tokens + 5M embed tokens per month?

sana: Basic perf + tokenizer checks: 3 business days if artifacts clean. Full quality + safety eval: +2 days. 32k context tuning: +3 days. So best-case 5 days, realistic 8 working days.

ev an: Legal timeline: BAA + Private deployment addendum tends to be 2-3 weeks. Thats the likely blocker.

billing-bot: cost-note: Hosted list rates for that volume are non-trivial. Recommend committed Dedicated for heavy gen; mixed routing (embeds hosted, gen dedicated) can reduce cost. Need peak qps and avg tokens/response to provide a concrete quote.

diego: Quick tokenizer check snippet to include in onboarding doc:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print(sum(len(i) for i in ids))"
```

sana: Minimal forward pass smoke test:
```
python -c "import torch; from loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,512)); out=m(x); print(out[0].shape)"
```

naomi: Ill request artifacts and 1k prompts + a simple data flow diagram. Also asking for peak concurrent streams and avg token lengths so billing can work a sketch.

diego: I can own perf sweep (quant/kernel candidates). Please provide a presigned s3 link (read-only). Ill allocate a small test batch and post perf matrix.

billing-bot: once we have avg seq length and 95p tokens/min we can produce a hosted vs committed cost comparison.

ev an: Security addendum: if embeddings index PHI we require index encryption, strict access controls, and periodic audit logging. Putting that on the checklist.

naomi: Thanks all. Ill update the deal doc and schedule a sync with ClearWell for Friday.

sec-bot: note: escalation required if BAA not signed within 10 business days.
